# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue using the feature request template.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template. Include your versions, how dnstwist runs, and the exact error text.
- **dnstwist itself** (permutations, lookups, output): see the [dnstwist project](https://github.com/elceef/dnstwist).
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately via [GitHub security advisories](https://github.com/w0h1v/mcp-dnstwist/security/advisories/new). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
